verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Admin API offering programmatic access, and separately runnable SDK examples in CodeSandbox. Nothing shows an interactive API reference, such as a try-it console or runnable request examples inside the reference itself. The CodeSandbox SDK examples are an adjacent feature, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
Explore our SDK examples directly in your browser with CodeSandbox.
